precision: FP32; inference_mode; eval; all parameters requires_grad=False; no AMP
rgb_resize: OpenCV INTER_CUBIC; short side target; dimensions independently rounded to nearest multiple of 14 using Python round; no padding/crop at evaluation
depth_restore: PyTorch bilinear align_corners=True, original image size
sample_order: axis 0 then axis 1; uniform without replacement, GT-valid endpoints only
sign_rule: GT abs(delta) > 1e-6; correct iff GT_delta * predicted_delta > 0
delta_sign: d(first endpoint) - d(second endpoint), same for prediction
edge_rule: minimum distance of either endpoint from original image edge
depth_bin_coordinate: mean GT depth of the two endpoints; [0,15),[15,20),[20,30),[30,65] m
pilot_selection: Two images per crop/view: sorted GT median (spatial step16) ranks floor(n*.25), floor(n*.75); tie image_relpath; before model results
tile_grid: stride=round(tile_size*(1-overlap)); last start anchored to far edge; actual last overlap may exceed nominal; no padding
tile_weight: outer(max(hann(height),1e-3), max(hann(width),1e-3)); normalize by weight sum
full_phase: Only after measured pilot results and a method lock

B3.trigger_before_full_results: selected B2 pilot RMSE > 1.5 times paired B0 pilot RMSE in either epoch, or mean tile overlap disagreement > 1 m
B3.lowpass_L: normalized square box filter, BORDER_REFLECT_101, original pixel coordinates
B3.parameter_policy: One prespecified diagnostic fusion; no GT-derived scale/offset and no posthoc radius/alpha search

bootstrap: 10000 image-paired replicates; seed42; Day047 descriptive uncertainty only
